title: indexové XML dávky, bajtově jako to, co ČSOB přijímá
interface: final class Drupal\csobrec\Service\IndexXml, no constructor arguments. Method build(array $lines, int $priorityCm = 50): string returns the whole document as bytes in a PHP string. Each $lines element is an array<string,string>. Field order inside <dokument> is fixed: soubor, prostredi, operator, id_kampane, telefon, id_callcentra, c_poj_sml — the first six are mandatory, c_poj_sml is written only when present. A line with an unknown key, or missing a mandatory one, throws \InvalidArgumentException naming the keys (never the values — the operator name is personal data). Lines end with CRLF including the last one, indentation is tabs, and &, < and > in values are escaped. Do not use DOMDocument or XMLWriter: they produce LF and their own formatting, and their importer rejects it.
